## Outreach brief

- **Lewis & Clark — San Diego counselor:** **Qwadere “Q” Lovell**, **Senior Assistant Dean of Admissions** (Southern California). Lewis & Clark’s county assignment page assigns **San Diego** to Lovell. Contact: **qlovell@lclark.edu** | **503-713-1203**. [San Diego county assignment](https://college.lclark.edu/offices/admissions/get_to_know_us/staff/counties/california/) · [official profile/contact](https://college.lclark.edu/live/profiles/13789-qwadere-q-lovell)

- **Hunter College Silberman MSW, Fall 2026:** The listed Fall MSW application deadline is **March 1**; supporting documents are due **March 15**. The table applies to the Two-Year Full-Time, Dual Degree–Bank Street, Advanced Standing, and One-Year Residency programs. [Silberman deadlines](https://sssw.hunter.cuny.edu/admissions/deadlines/)

- **Indiana University Kokomo — graduate-level catalog entries:** I treated “graduate programs” as all entries the official academic catalog labels master’s, specialist, graduate certificate, or post-baccalaureate certificate (including the catalog’s separately listed accelerated master’s pathway):
  - **Master’s / specialist:** MBA—Business Administration; MS—Criminal Justice and Public Safety; Specialist—Educational Leadership; MS—Educational Technology for Learning; MA—English; MS—Family Nurse Practitioner; MA—History; MAT—Biology, Chemistry, History, Mathematics, and Political Science; Master of Liberal Studies; MS—Management; MA—Mental Health Counseling; MS—MGT MS-Online from Accounting BS-Online or Business Admin BSBA-Online; MS—Nursing Administration; MS—Nursing Education; MA—Political Science; Master of Public Management; Specialist—School Psychology; MS—Science of Reading; MS—Strategic Finance; MS—Teaching, Learning, and Curriculum.
  - **Graduate / post-baccalaureate certificates:** Accounting (post-baccalaureate); Advanced Medical Imaging Technology (post-baccalaureate); Alcohol and Drug Counseling; Biology; Business Fundamentals; Chemistry; Communication Studies; Composition Studies; Criminal Justice Leadership and Management; Health Management; History; Informatics (post-baccalaureate); Language and Literature; Leadership; Literature; Mathematics (graduate and post-baccalaureate listings); Nursing Administration (post-baccalaureate); Nursing Education (post-baccalaureate); Political Science; Public Management; Teaching English Learners.
  - The catalog marks online availability where applicable; the above retains its distinct program titles rather than silently merging them. [Official catalog, pp. 1–2](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html?page=1) · [pp. 3–4](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html?page=3) · [pp. 5–7](https://www.iuk.edu/academics/index.html?page=5)

- **UCSF glioblastoma trials in Northern California:** UCSF’s live glioblastoma page currently labels these **“open to eligible people”** (i.e., recruiting):
  1. **Anti-EGFRvIII synNotch Receptor Induced Anti-EphA2/IL-13Ralpha2 CAR (E-SYNC) T Cells** — **San Francisco, California** — open to eligible people **18+**.
  2. **DOC1021 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy for Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Adult Glioblastoma (GBM)** — **San Francisco, California and other locations** — open to eligible people **18+**.
  3. Also listed: **DB107-RRV, DB107-FC, and Radiation Therapy With or Without Temozolomide (TMZ) for High Grade Glioma** — **San Francisco and other locations** — open to eligible people **18+**.
  [UCSF Glioblastoma clinical-trials listing](https://clinicaltrials.ucsf.edu/glioblastoma)

- **ORU student-activities contact:** ORU’s Student Association Executive Team—described as the team that serves questions about campus events, shuttles, intramurals, and clubs—lists **Augustine Mendoza** as **Director of Student Experience**. Officially posted contact: **augiemendoza@oru.edu**. (No direct phone is posted on that team page.) [ORU Student Association Executive Team](https://oru.edu/current-students/my-campus-life/student-association/cabinet/index.php)

- **EDF Energy graduate-programme pay-review language:** In EDF Energy’s official *Early careers at EDF* graduate/placement brochure, the wording is: **“Starting salary is £35,000. You’ll receive annual increases, plus annual bonus, relocation allowances and other flexible benefits.”** This is an archived **2023–24** brochure, so it is useful as the exact official language but should not be treated as a current offer term; EDF’s current graduate-careers page should be checked for the specific vacancy. [Official EDF archived brochure (PDF)](https://www.edfenergy.com/sites/default/files/graduate_and_placement_brochure_2023_2024.pdf) · [current EDF graduate careers page](https://careers.edfenergy.com/graduate-careers)

P1_asked_for.reason: It provides concrete answers and official links for Lewis & Clark, Hunter, IU Kokomo, UCSF, and EDF, but the ORU answer identifies a "Director of Student Experience" rather than clearly verifying the staff member who directs student activities, and the EDF quote concerns annual increases rather than explicitly answering salary reviews.

P2_readable_for_them.reason: The well-organized, compact bullet summary, direct quotations, and explicit caveat about the EDF brochure are readily understandable for this research-capable, detail-oriented user.

P4_gap_handling.reason: It explicitly states its interpretation of IU Kokomo's graduate-program scope and flags that the EDF wording is from an archived 2023–24 brochure rather than silently presenting it as current.
